attunement.changingSet: Requires ending and establishing attunement using normal rules; not in-combat swapping
attunement.triadActivation: Exactly the three required artifacts attuned; extra non-artifact attunements cannot exceed limit
attunement.pathSelection: Triad composition determines available path; player chooses by attunement loadout
attunement.activationRules: One triad power per long rest per character; individual item uses are separate

items.name: Eye of the Caterpillar
items.passive: Advantage on one Investigation check involving magical illusions per long rest
items.ability: Unblinking Mark: bonus action mark one visible target within 60 feet for 1 minute; first spell hit each turn against it deals +1d4 psychic; concentration; 1/long rest
items.spellcasting: Spell use from item does not grant permanent knowledge of spell

items.name: Mirror of the White Queen
items.passive: +1 to saving throws against being charmed or frightened
items.ability: Merciful Reflection: reaction when ally within 30 feet takes damage, reduce by 1d8 + proficiency bonus; 1/long rest
items.spellcasting: Spell use from item does not grant permanent knowledge of spell

items.name: Crown of the Red Queen
items.ability: Checkmate: when you hit with an attack, deal +1d6 force damage and move yourself 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks; 1/long rest
items.spellcasting: Spell use from item does not grant permanent knowledge of spell

items.name: Hourglass of the White Rabbit
items.ability: Borrowed Moment: reaction after failing a Dexterity saving throw, add +1d4 to the result; 1/long rest
items.spellcasting: Spell use from item does not grant permanent knowledge of spell

items.name: Heart of the Jabberwock
items.passive: Resistance to one chosen damage type (fire, cold, lightning, acid) selected on attunement
items.ability: Vorpal Pulse: action, 15-foot cone, 3d6 chosen attunement damage type, Dexterity save for half; 1/long rest
items.spellcasting: Spell use from item does not grant permanent knowledge of spell

triads.name: The Shattered Crown
triads.effect: Choose fire, cold, lightning or acid. One creature within 60 feet makes a Dexterity save against artifact DC 15, taking 6d8 chosen damage on failure or half on success. If standing in a DM-marked compatible hazard, add 1d8 once; no automatic environmental ignition.
triads.limit: Cannot stack with another triad ability on same turn

triads.name: The Unbroken Mirror
triads.activation: Reaction when you or ally within 30 feet takes damage
triads.effect: Reduce triggering damage by 4d8 + proficiency bonus, then grant the protected creature temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus. This reduction occurs after resistance; no retroactive healing.

triads.name: The Infinite Key
triads.effect: You and up to two willing creatures within 10 feet teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 60 feet, provided the destination is on the same plane and not warded against teleportation. You also learn whether one nearby portal is active, but not its destination.
triads.limit: No planar travel or bypass of sealed chronology gates

designNotes: Exactly five items; three chosen attunements produce one of three defined triad powers.
Other three-item combinations grant their individual item abilities but no triad power.
Normal action economy applies; no free bonus actions.
Artifact ownership does not imply attunement or an unlocked triad.
Unlocks require quest evidence and DM approval.
Does not replace or auto-grant previously locked divine treasury rewards.
